shape: Square arena with twin entry hubs (N+E gates)
description: Same twin-hub-arena primitive as wetlands-A ib1, but with portals on PERPENDICULAR sides (north + east) instead of opposite sides. Each gate has its own entry hub (north_inner, east_inner) and both hubs fully connect to the same 5 detour anchors (4 corners + center). The hubs DON'T directly link — N↔E transit always passes through one of the shared anchors.

portals.north: spawn_north at (-5.99, -25.59) — gate on the north (low-Z) side
portals.east: spawn_east at (25.30, 5.97) — gate on the east (high-X) side

traversalNotes: Direct N↔E: spawn_north → north_inner → arena_center → east_inner → spawn_east. Four hops (L-route through center).
DISPATCH RULE: same as wetlands-A ib1 — corner objectives route via the entering side's inner hub. Both hubs reach all 5 detour anchors, so the entering-side dispatch is always the shortest.

Same primitive as wetlands-A ib1 (twin entry hubs) but with N+E gates instead of N+S. Note the 5 detour anchors here (center + south_center + 3 corners — NE is missing) reflect the actual room layout being not-quite-symmetric.
